# ovrin public API surface.
#
# One line per exported symbol, struct field and interface method, sorted.
# Generated by `go test -run TestAPI -update .`; committed so that any change
# to the public API is a visible line in a diff that somebody had to intend.
# The format follows Go's own api/go1.N.txt. Parameter names are dropped —
# a rename should not churn this file; `go mirror` fences check those.
#
# Until the code exists this file is hand-authored and is the SPECIFICATION:
# the generator is red until the source matches it. See ADR-0024 for what
# happens to this file at v1.0.
#
